name: kmj-codebridge
description: Secure, project-scoped AI coding across authorized computers and VPSs through one MCP bridge. Developer preview.

interface.shortDescription: Project-scoped AI coding across your authorized devices
interface.longDescription: Connect AI-assisted development to approved projects on your laptops, workstations and VPSs through one authenticated MCP bridge. Inspect code, make guarded file changes, check Git state and run administrator-defined quality gates without exposing an unrestricted shell. Developer preview; hosted onboarding and commercial plans are delivered separately through KMJ TECHNO.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my authorized project with KMJ CodeBridge.
Show Git status and run my configured quality gates.
Check my CodeBridge connection and latest job results.
